global:
Xianxia painterly illustration, refined brushwork, elegant anatomy, richly layered silk and deep colour. Preserve the individual's established face, gender/presentation, apparent age, build, hair, eyes, garments, materials, species and current condition. Beauty and cosmic dread coexist; do not impose a uniform face or occupation costume.

MANDATORY FORM SOURCES. Follow the applicable npcType Visual method and the individual's Appearance / True Form. visualDescription must portray that same existence, not replace it with a restrained bust or aura-only person. Established species, actual Path rank and individual exceptions govern generic type suggestions. Identity duplicated across dossier and portrait is intentional; no new form or powers may be inferred from atmosphere.

FRAMING. Portrait orientation, complete readable face away from crop edges. Humanlike figures stand in their individual authored pose, head to approximately knees, looking directly at the viewer: three-quarter BODY, not a three-quarter face. Preserve defining hands, wings, horns and tails. Closed, blind or injured eyes keep their condition. Mermaids rise on a coiled tail with no human legs. Mature sensuality remains adult and non-graphic.

ACTUAL ATTAINMENT FIRST. Resolve each current Qi, Body and Martial Path independently. Neither location, ancient age, immortal ancestry, service to a powerful master nor a technique's name grants an immortal body. Below immortality use the actual local area and individual gesture, preserving Changning's moonless sky. A mortal inside an enclosed lower world remains mortal even when the parent map says Immortal Universe. An immortal visiting such a world retains their true-form illustration.

QI / BODY IMMORTALS. A readable humanlike or species visage is the nearest expression of ONE immense existence, not a small person in front of a giant duplicate. The actually cultivated Dao forms connected anatomy: electrical vessels, refining chambers, blood, roots, scales, seas, petals, spatial folds or other established substance. Follow a near wrist, throat, cheek, shoulder or garment contour into the greater circulation or structure. Include one or two concrete scale cues and tangible layers, occlusion and depth. No generic galaxy wallpaper, aura-only silhouette or invented affinity. Qi expression may radiate outward; Body density and circulation gather inward through the actual refined vessel.

RANK. True Immortal: already colossal and impossible, but legible as a cultivated person. Immortal Lord: unmistakably astronomical, with worlds or suns small between deeper anatomical layers. Sovereign: the actual governing Dao takes recognisable personal shape, not merely larger ornament. True Venerable: a clear visage anchors an existence too extensive for a lesser mind to assemble; immensity comes from law and continuity, not random monster parts. These bodily steps apply only to the Qi or Body component that has truly attained them.

NONHUMAN IDENTITY. Trees, lotus, dragons, phoenixes, tigers, turtles and other real bodies remain anatomically recognisable and occupy the greater composition. Their established humanlike semblance belongs within the nearest connected structures, sharing veins, scales, bark, feathers or circulation. No rider, pet, summoned double or species replacement. A human who learned phoenix methods does not grow ancestral phoenix anatomy without an actual transformation.

MARTIAL AND MIXED PATHS. Pure Martial bodies remain human-sized; cosmic reach is the Art, intent and consequence around that same body. In a hybrid, use the highest ACTUAL immortal Qi/Body component for giant anatomy, not the highest rank anywhere in the dossier. A Martial Sovereign with Body Foundation does not have a Sovereign Body. If only Martial is immortal, keep bodily scale and place vastness in the Art.

INDIVIDUAL EXCEPTIONS. Heavenly Punishment is lightning-first: retain real Winged anatomy but let judgment-lightning, not ornamental plumage, dominate. Endless Despair retains the human-sized outline and immeasurable shadow. Shi Sanyue is exactly three adult Past, Present and Future forms of ONE person. Bitter Dew's medicinal seed-body and captive semblance remain enclosed by the dark-green cauldron and its three intact binding bands; no opened prison or free avatar.

SOCIAL AND SCENE CONTINUITY. Independent immortal peers retain personal stature regardless of tending, tea, craft or hospitality. Do not dress them as a generic labouring class. Established service to a higher immortal never shrinks their own attained form. Scene restraint, real existence and portrait presentation are distinct: UI art neither releases presence nor causes exposure, descent, new powers, knowledge or duplication. In-world representations retain their actual harmful channels. No text, interfaces, watermarks, gratuitous extra anatomy or unrelated cosmic creatures.
